digest.component_or_area: rebar repository maintenance and janitor audit
propositions: A comprehensive codebase-health audit must be conducted across the rebar repository covering code debt, architectural smells, separation-of-concerns problems, documentation gaps, oversized units, weak test oracles, and security smells.
Discovery phase must produce path:line-cited findings per concern without severity or confidence scores; all shards must complete or remain as explicit coverage gaps.
Independent verification must establish validity (threshold 0.75) and impact (threshold 0.5) for each candidate; prior decisions and known-fine entries must be consulted and recorded.
Remediation proposals must be asymmetric (community practice versus project record), converged at move/end-state level, and researched for divergences before remediation plan entry.
Approved remediation work must be ticketized as child tickets under a Janitor Cleanup epic with acceptance criteria, provenance, dependencies, and file impact linked back to this audit ticket.
Audit artifacts and reusable playbook must be persisted at `.joe-janitor/` convention with no changes made to production code, tests, or configuration outside tracker and designated audit tree.
